name: Liquidity Lab World Economy Evidence Catalog
description: A public catalog that routes financial-plumbing questions to three distinct evidence layers: Seiche for system-wide dollar funding and global money-market context, LiquiLens for bank and lender failure-risk screening, and Undertow for market-liquidity and position-sized exit evidence. It is not a complete database of the world economy.

dataset.name: LiquiLens Bank and Lender Early-Warning Evidence
dataset.description: Disclosure-based bank and lender screening built from public filings, funding structure, regulatory thresholds and market signals. Its public historical evidence keeps the India, United States and Europe records separate, names misses, and carries explicit validated-backtest and real-money eligibility flags.
dataset.keywords: bank failure early warning, lender distress, NBFC risk, MFI risk, FDIC failures, RBI thresholds, construction-PIT
dataset.measurementTechnique: India is a filing-availability-proxied construction-PIT diagnostic; the United States is a current-amended construction-PIT diagnostic; Europe is seven named case files rather than a cohort estimate. All three currently report validated_backtest_eligible=false and real_money_eligible=false.

dataset.name: Seiche Dollar-Funding and Money-Market Evidence
dataset.description: A free public-data terminal for US dollar funding stress with a live regime, source-specific clocks, forward event odds, historical analogs, a granular USD money-market desk and a licence-aware global money-market atlas. Registered markets, live coverage and validation support are reported as separate claims.
dataset.spatialCoverage: US dollar funding system, with a licence-aware global money-market discovery atlas
dataset.keywords: US dollar funding, SOFR, IORB, repo, reserves, Treasury General Account, Standing Repo Facility, global money markets
dataset.measurementTechnique: Public Federal Reserve, New York Fed, Office of Financial Research, Treasury and other source series retain their native publication clocks. The historical diagnostic is FINAL_VINTAGE_CONSTRUCTION_PIT with validated_backtest_eligible=false and real_money_eligible=false.

dataset.name: Undertow Market-Liquidity and Exit-Cost Evidence
dataset.description: A public market-liquidity summary covering provider concentration, market-depth fragility, segment evidence states and position-sized exit costs where observable. A PARTIAL or UNAVAILABLE segment is an evidence warning, never a calm reading, and historical replays remain separately labeled construction-PIT evidence.
dataset.spatialCoverage: Cross-market: US Treasuries, credit, equities, ETFs, FX, China, crypto and borrowed stock
dataset.keywords: market liquidity, exit cost, market depth, venue concentration, liquidity providers, cross-market fragility
dataset.measurementTechnique: Each measure is scored only against its own history after coverage and replay gates clear. Historical replay status is CONSTRUCTION_PIT with truncated-latest vintages, validated_backtest_eligible=false and real_money_eligible=false.
